question.prompt: In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\), \(\angle B=60^\circ\), and \(BC=3\). Find the length of \(AB\).

solutions.explanation: \(\angle A=30^\circ\), and its opposite leg \(BC\) equals half the hypotenuse, so \(AB=2BC=6\).
solutions.title: Find the 30° angle and double its opposite leg
